title: Train What You Run: Probabilistic Convolutions for Learning Token Compaction in State Space Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual token compaction reduces inference cost by passing only selected image patches or video tokens to later layers. In sequence models with local convolutions, each removal changes which tokens are neighbors. Learning which tokens to keep therefore requires a training signal that accounts for the new neighborhoods. We introduce ProbConv, which computes the exact expected convolution before activation at a kept position under independent keep decisions. The operator is differentiable in the keep probabilities. With binary decisions, ProbConv and step gating reproduce the compacted Mamba block. Across image, vision--language and video backbones, ProbConv is strongest under strong compaction: its advantage over matched training controls grows as more tokens are removed. translated_title: 训练即推理：状态空间模型中用于学习视觉令牌压缩的概率卷积
translated_abstract: 视觉令牌压缩通过仅将选定的图像块或视频令牌传递到后续层，从而降低推理成本。在采用局部卷积的序列模型中，每移除一个令牌都会改变哪些令牌互为邻居。因此，学习保留哪些令牌需要一种能够考虑这种新邻居关系的训练信号。我们提出了 ProbConv，它在独立保留决策的条件下，计算保留位置在激活之前的精确期望卷积。该算子关于保留概率是可微的。当采用二值决策时，ProbConv 与步进门控可以复现压缩后的 Mamba 模块。在图像、视觉—语言以及视频骨干网络上的实验表明，ProbConv 在强压缩情形下优势最为明显：随着移除的令牌越来越多，它相对于同等训练设置的对照方法的优势也不断增大。在 Cobra 模型上，在相同的推理预算下，它还优于已发表的视觉—语言剪枝方法的适配版本。ProbConv 相对于同等的零掩码训练也有提升……
tldr: 本文提出 ProbConv——一种关于令牌保留概率可微的概率卷积算子，可计算独立保留决策下的精确期望卷积，使状态空间模型（如 Mamba）的训练与推理时的令牌压缩保持一致，且压缩越强其优势越明显。
en_tdlr: ProbConv is a differentiable probabilistic convolution that computes the exact expected convolution under independent token-keep decisions, aligning training with token-compacted inference in state space models, with gains that grow as more tokens are removed.
